tool_input.command: sed -n 1490,1500p packages/workflow/src/interfaces.ts; grep -rn "isString\|UnexpectedError\|UserError" packages/nodes-base/nodes/KoBoToolbox/*.ts | head; grep -rln "getNodeParameter(.*)) *$" packages/nodes-base/nodes | head -0; grep -n "body" packages/nodes-base/nodes/KoBoToolbox/GenericFunctions.ts | head -5
tool_input.description: Check getNodeParameter overloads and helper usage

result:
I removed the `as` casts from the new `setValidationMany` code. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked.

Changes:

- **`KoBoToolbox.node.ts`**: The `submissionIds` and `validationStatus` parameters no longer use `as string`.
  - `submissionIds` goes straight into `parseSubmissionIds`, which now takes `unknown`.
  - `validationStatus` is checked with `typeof status !== 'string'`. If the check fails, it throws a `NodeOperationError`.
  - `NodeOperationError` is now imported from `n8n-workflow` in this file.
- **`GenericFunctions.ts`**: `parseSubmissionIds` takes `value: unknown`. It still converts the value with `toString`, which accepts any input.

A check of the added lines in the diff finds no remaining ` as ` casts. The existing `as string` casts elsewhere in `KoBoToolbox.node.ts` predate this change, so I left them alone.
